inferred_preconditions: Assistant message has a run ID, complete status and completed run outcome.
No visible run error or still-running tool remains.
Native mode is not reclassified as inferred, including native pending, missing_final and conflict.
Any persisted validation=conflict, including legacy mode, prevents inferred fallback.
All text blocks have logical message IDs and only unknown or absent phase values.
The final nonempty logical text item is chosen by first-appearance order of distinct message IDs.
No tool block occurs after the first fragment of that final logical text item.
implementation.inferred_presentation: Keep every fragment of the final logical text item visible; collect earlier text and eligible ordinary tools into existing execution sections without changing block order, IDs or source phase fields.
implementation.message_list_binding: One derived policy drives both section membership and default collapse; data-execution-disclosure-source exposes the presentation source for diagnostics.
implementation.persistence: No new persistent phase facts or model-history transformations are introduced by this display increment.

test_coverage_summary: Source text, phases and identities remain unchanged; native and inferred policies stay separate.
Fragmented logical messages, late fragments, blank items and tools after the last logical message are handled conservatively.
Running, cancelled, failed, untrusted old terminal and any persisted conflict, including legacy conflict, do not become inferred success.
Request tools, warnings, errors and fixed visible facts stay outside inferred process sections.
Trusted durable and AG-UI completion agree; push done alone does not prove run success.
